result.summary: The user interface is well-structured, showing only two minor styling and accessibility issues.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder and secondary delivery information have low color contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text weight or darken the grey color to meet accessibility standards.

issues.description: The red notification indicator on the profile icon appears slightly off-center and floating.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the badge position to align more precisely with the icon's corner.
